utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late as usual, but I can still help where it’s needed most. What’s the biggest task left?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need hands for the fence fix and sorting the donated tools. If you can jump in, the fence is probably the biggest thing left.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you bring a few basic tools and any spare screws you have? If you’re not sure, just bring them and I’ll sort through them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring some basic tools and any spare screws I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got and make a list of what still needs to be gathered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that'd be great, thanks. I might've missed a few things, so a list would really help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I’ll take a look and write it up for you. I’ll bring you the list as soon as I’ve checked everything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. We still need some tools, a few spare parts, and ideally someone to help coordinate pickups so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help coordinate the pickups and keep track of what’s still missing. Send me the list, and I’ll start reaching out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we already decide which repairs need the most help, or are we still making the list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m not sure we’ve settled it yet. Want me to ask around and see what people think needs priority?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please ask around. I want to know which jobs are urgent so we can focus the drive where it matters most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s still on and folks are bringing in tools and old parts this afternoon. If you’re heading over, I’d go sooner rather than later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for the heads-up, Tess. I’ll swing by sooner rather than later and see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good plan, Gus—there’s usually a little crowd by midafternoon. If you find anything useful, I’m sure they’ll be glad to have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, put me down for it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve got you on the list—thanks, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, I just wanted to make sure you were really in. Can you confirm you’ll be there for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m in and I’ll be there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive list started, and I’ll keep everything organized. If you know of any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll send any houses I notice needing help your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep a running list and make sure we get everyone covered.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive—trying to keep everyone in the loop. If you hear anyone who wants to help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Vik. If I hear of anyone, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Eli—I appreciate it. I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive — thanks for reminding me. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just a little help, if you can. I’m having a rough time keeping up on my own.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, I can help however I can. What should I do first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That repair drive sounds like a great way to help out the neighborhood. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Honestly, just spreading the word would help a lot. If you can, send folks our way with any tools, spare parts, or a little time to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll spread the word and send anyone my way who has tools, spare parts, or a bit of time to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’ve been telling everyone about it, and I can spread the word to a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I might show up a little late, but I can still bring something useful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Dane—anything helps, and I’ll make sure folks know you’re coming late. Swing by whenever you can!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard folks are pitching in for the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job. Once that’s set, we can get the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I'll help put together the broken-items list and see who can take each job.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m trying to keep things around the school schedule, so I’ll need to see when the repair drive is happening. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye — I’m thinking we can set the repair drive for Saturday morning, around 10 a.m. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I’m happy to help connect everyone for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and see who can bring tools or lend a hand? I’ll keep you posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and see who can bring tools or pitch in. Keep me posted, and I’ll share any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I just want to make sure we’ve got the tools and timing sorted so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring over my toolbox and we can make a quick list of what’s still needed. Just tell me when the drive starts, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the repair drive is still at the community center—want me to check the exact room?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, please—that would be great. If you can check the exact room, I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, I’ll head over and check which room it’s in. I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I can help sort things out if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina, yes, I think so—but I want to double-check the details before we commit. Can you remind me what time and where we’re starting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I was thinking we could start at the community center around 10 a.m. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and make a quick list of what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a quick list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still catching up on the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive—I've been a bit out of the loop. I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries—just let me know when you hear anything. I’m mostly trying to figure out what still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right? Just want to make sure before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for real—looks like the neighborhood repair drive is on. Go ahead and tell people!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, great—I just wanted to confirm. I’ll let people know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear there’s a repair drive going on. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate that—every bit helps right now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. Start by checking the side gate latch, then see if the porch light bulb needs replacing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll check the side gate latch first, then take a look at the porch light bulb.
